purpose: LINE rich menu availability, candidate acquisition method, and read-only Android UI processing time capacity survey

sampling.method: Evenly spaced selection across the P-WORLD LINE table after exact normalized store-name join to canonical hall master; forced inclusion of the three Kanagawa shops already present in the dedicated Android chat list.

line_sources_csv.note: The file is absent at current slot HEAD; it was read from this historical revision. The P-WORLD 2026-09-23 list provided confirmed source keys for the wider sample.

sampling.source_table_scope: Only the primary LINE table at lines 9-315; supplementary tables elsewhere in the Markdown were excluded.

processing_time.percentile_method: linear interpolation; n=3, interpret as preliminary
estimate_limitations: only 3 accessible Kanagawa chats were timed
47 of the selected targets were not accessible as existing chats
friend additions/onboarding and worker contention excluded
linear projections are not measured 50/100/300-store runs

summary.one_worker_throughput_assessment: 3件の直接観測平均は約62店舗/時。全件が既存トークとしてアクセス可能なら300件は約4.8時間の線形試算だが、この調査では50件完了していない。1 workerで成立するかは暫定。2 workersなら約2.4時間、4 workersなら約1.2時間の単純割り算で、必要性は日次締切次第。

quality_check.aviva_absence_review: Passed final recheck: two new dumps, same target header, zero progress nodes, zero rich-menu nodes, normal composer present, screenshot bottom rendering reviewed.

records.notes: 対象タイトルが2回のdumpで一致。progressなし。chat_ui_oa_richmenuとimageviewが実画面に表示。2026-09-24の既存PoCでrich-menuとtext-triggerの両方式がsuccess。今回の調査では送信・menuクリックなし。

observation_evidence.source: existing PoC manifest and current read-only UI dumps

records.notes: 初回2 dumpと最終QAの2 dumpで対象タイトルが一致し、progress/menu nodeなし。正常な入力欄と描画済みチャットが表示され、最終QAスクリーンショットでも画面下部の正常描画を再確認。既存会話履歴に「最新情報」送信と返信URLあり（今回の送信ではない）。
